defects.description: Packing narrows the row count to 16 bits, so unpacking loses valid rows in large input arrays.
defects.why_missed: S9(b): round-trip preservation fails only at 65536 rows or more; ordinary row counts execute the same statement correctly.

defects.description: Independently decoding byte chunks replaces a valid Unicode character split across chunks.
defects.why_missed: S9(b): complete text preservation is checked for 3000 labels; no valid UTF-8 input within the default 4096-byte chunk can expose this defect, and long ASCII inputs remain correct.
